task.title: Add docs/trustmybot/tasks/README.md cutover note; verify hooks treat completed historical XMLs as ignored
task.description:
Phase 1 produced 7 XML specs. Phase 2 produces ~9 XML specs (this one included). After Phase 2 lands on `dev`, all new specs are markdown per docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md. The historical XMLs must stay in tree (audit trail; PR review provenance) but should not gate any future workflow.
Two actions:
**1. Author `docs/trustmybot/tasks/README.md`:**
```markdown # Task Specs
All NEW task specs are markdown — see `docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md`.
Filenames map from `branch_id` with `/` → `-`:
feat/user-login → docs/trustmybot/tasks/feat-user-login.md
## Historical XML specs
Files matching `phase-1-*.xml` and `phase-2-*.xml` are HISTORICAL. They were the format used during the v0.3 Phase 1 + Phase 2 transition. They are kept in tree as an audit trail and are NOT regenerated. Their `<reviewed-by>` / `<closed-by>` tags are the canonical sign-off record for those tasks; SQLite `validation_attempts` is empty for them (the rows pre-date Phase 2 schema migration).
`scripts/hooks/require-review-sign.sh` skips any XML spec with `status="completed"` AND a `<reviewed-by>` tag — historical XMLs pass through automatically. ```
**2. Verify hook behavior — NO code change unless the hook does NOT already pass through historical XMLs:**
Read `scripts/hooks/require-review-sign.sh` (post-Phase 2 task `phase-2-hook-sqlite-migration` has rewritten it). Confirm: - On a system WITH a populated DB: the hook queries `validation_attempts` for SQLite-backed tasks; XML files are ignored (not iterated). Historical XMLs pass. - On the legacy fallback path (no DB): the hook iterates `*.xml` only and skips files with `<reviewed-by>` AND `status="completed"`. Verify this skip exists in the legacy loop. If it does NOT, add it.
The hook check semantics SHOULD already be correct after `phase-2-hook-sqlite-migration` (legacy XMLs grep continues to use the existing skip-on-`<reviewed-by>` logic). This task verifies and documents.
DO NOT delete or migrate any historical `phase-1-*.xml` or `phase-2-*.xml` file. They stay verbatim.

files.file: Verbatim per the description above. Replace the `<reviewed-by>` / `<closed-by>` and `status="completed"` examples with literal angle brackets in the markdown (escape with backticks).

ONLY edit if verification step 2 above shows the legacy-fallback grep loop does NOT skip XMLs that have both `<reviewed-by>` AND `status="completed"`. If it already skips: no change. Document the verification result either way in the `<results>` block.

task.success-criteria: - `docs/trustmybot/tasks/README.md` exists and explains the cutover. - `docs/trustmybot/tasks/README.md` cites `SPEC-FORMAT.md`. - `docs/trustmybot/tasks/README.md` documents that historical XMLs are kept as audit trail and not regenerated. - All 7 Phase 1 XMLs and all 9 Phase 2 XMLs (this one included) remain in tree, byte-identical to their pre-task state. - `require-review-sign.sh` legacy-fallback path skips XMLs with both `<reviewed-by>` AND `status="completed"` (verified or fixed). - Smoke test: with an in-tree historical XML (`docs/trustmybot/tasks/phase-1-rename-task-hook.xml`, which has `status="completed"` and `<reviewed-by>`), hook does NOT block a `git push` simulation.
task.out-of-scope: - Migrating any XML to markdown (deliberate non-action). - Deleting any XML file. - Changing how the new SQLite path treats markdown specs. - Changing the require-task-spec.sh hook (file-based, not affected).
